source: TSTD project (Technical Assistance 7305-CAM, TA 7305-CAM), "បច្ចេកទេសដាំដំណាំពោត" (Corn Cultivation Technical Manual), cover and foreword pages, May 2012
text:
This corn cultivation technical manual was produced under the TSTD project (Technical Assistance for Strengthening Agricultural Product Diversity, TA 7305-CAM), which supports partner agricultural cooperatives and farmer groups with financing from a development partner (referred to as AusAID) and technical partnership with a private seed company, East West Seed International, for seed distribution in the target provinces (Kampong Thom and Kampong Chhnang mentioned as project areas, with Kandal and Prey Veng also mentioned elsewhere in project materials).

The manual was compiled by the project's agriculture and marketing team to give participating farmer groups practical technical guidance for growing corn and other crops as a diversified income-generating cash crop, alongside instruction in basic record-keeping and cost-benefit analysis so farmers can evaluate the profitability of production themselves. The document is dated May 2012 and lists Mr. Liv Leanghy as the project's agriculture and marketing officer responsible for reviewing and disseminating the technical manual (contact: livleanghy@gmail.com), with Mr. Prak Chan Arithya named as project coordinator.
